title: Hymn of the Quiet Mother
author: the Veiled Choir
pages: Hush, little wound, the light is ending. Hush, little wound, the night is near. Before the sun there was a stillness. Before the stars, no hunger here.
She does not burn. She does not grieve. She does not count the dead or born. She holds the world as dark holds water. She waits for us beyond the dawn.
The Jailer in the Hollow keeps us. The Jailer bleeds the world with light. Sing soft, sing low, and when it falters, open the door and let in night.
We give the cold ones back to Her. We give the unremembered rest. And those who sing shall never die, but reign in quiet, and be blessed.
